name: Royal Roastery
note: Agrees with OpenStreetMap. Read: Visit us 1055 S Sherman St, Suite 100 Richardson, TX 75081 (737) 800-8555 ... Open Until Midnight Every Night; schema.org: Mo-Su 07:00-24:00 The visible text gives the closing time only; the opening time is the page's schema.org, accepted because it equals OpenStreetMap's hours. Branch page matched by address and phone. Four shops (New Orleans, Houston, two in Richardson).
